<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <?import javafx.geometry.Insets?> <?import javafx.collections.FXCollections?> <?import java.lang.String?> <?import javafx.scene.control.*?> <?import javafx.scene.layout.*?>
<ScrollPane fitToWidth="true" hbarPolicy="NEVER" xmlns="http://javafx.com/javafx/17" xmlns:fx="http://javafx.com/fxml/1" fx:controller="com.rh.contollers.EmployeController" styleClass="content-scroll"> <content> <VBox spacing="12" style="-fx-background-color: #F0E6DA; -fx-padding: 18;">
<!-- HEADER --> <HBox spacing="12" style="-fx-background-color:#1A0406; -fx-padding:12; -fx-alignment:center-left; -fx-border-radius:6; -fx-background-radius:6;"> <Label style="-fx-background-color:#75070C; -fx-padding:8; -fx-background-radius:6; -fx-text-fill:white; -fx-font-weight:bold;" text="＋" /> <VBox> <Label text="Nouvel employé" styleClass="page-title" /> <Label text="Remplissez tous les champs obligatoires" style="-fx-text-fill:#886670; -fx-font-size:11;" /> </VBox> </HBox>
<!-- SECTION 1: Informations personnelles --> <VBox spacing="8" styleClass="card"> <Label text="INFORMATIONS PERSONNELLES" styleClass="section-title-label" /> <GridPane hgap="14" vgap="12"> <columnConstraints> <ColumnConstraints percentWidth="33" /> <ColumnConstraints percentWidth="33" /> <ColumnConstraints percentWidth="34" /> </columnConstraints>
<!-- Row 1 --> <Label text="Matricule:" GridPane.rowIndex="0" GridPane.columnIndex="0" /> <Label fx:id="lblMatricule" styleClass="auto-id-badge" GridPane.rowIndex="0" GridPane.columnIndex="1" />
<Label text="Situation familiale:" GridPane.rowIndex="0" GridPane.columnIndex="2" /> <HBox spacing="6" GridPane.rowIndex="1" GridPane.columnIndex="2"> <ToggleButton fx:id="tbSitCelib" text="Célibataire" styleClass="toggle-dept" /> <ToggleButton fx:id="tbSitMarie" text="Marié(e)" styleClass="toggle-dept" /> <ToggleButton fx:id="tbSitDivorce" text="Divorcé(e)" styleClass="toggle-dept" /> <ToggleButton fx:id="tbSitVeuf" text="Veuf(ve)" styleClass="toggle-dept" /> </HBox>
<!-- Row 2 --> <Label text="Nom:" GridPane.rowIndex="2" GridPane.columnIndex="0" /> <TextField fx:id="tfNom" styleClass="form-field" GridPane.rowIndex="2" GridPane.columnIndex="0" GridPane.columnSpan="1" /> <Label text="Prénom:" GridPane.rowIndex="2" GridPane.columnIndex="1" /> <TextField fx:id="tfPrenom" styleClass="form-field" GridPane.rowIndex="2" GridPane.columnIndex="1" /> <Label text="Date de naissance:" GridPane.rowIndex="2" GridPane.columnIndex="2" /> <DatePicker fx:id="dpNaissance" GridPane.rowIndex="2" GridPane.columnIndex="2" />
<!-- Row 3 --> <Label text="CIN:" GridPane.rowIndex="3" GridPane.columnIndex="0" /> <TextField fx:id="tfCIN" styleClass="form-field" GridPane.rowIndex="3" GridPane.columnIndex="0" /> <Label text="Téléphone:" GridPane.rowIndex="3" GridPane.columnIndex="1" /> <TextField fx:id="tfTelephone" styleClass="form-field" GridPane.rowIndex="3" GridPane.columnIndex="1" /> <Label text="N° CNSS:" GridPane.rowIndex="3" GridPane.columnIndex="2" /> <TextField fx:id="tfCNSS" styleClass="form-field" GridPane.rowIndex="3" GridPane.columnIndex="2" />
<!-- error labels --> <Label fx:id="errNom" textFill="#75070C" GridPane.rowIndex="4" GridPane.columnIndex="0" /> <Label fx:id="errCIN" textFill="#75070C" GridPane.rowIndex="4" GridPane.columnIndex="1" /> <Label fx:id="errTelephone" textFill="#75070C" GridPane.rowIndex="4" GridPane.columnIndex="2" /> </GridPane> </VBox>
<!-- SECTION 2: Informations professionnelles --> <VBox spacing="8" styleClass="card"> <Label text="INFORMATIONS PROFESSIONNELLES" styleClass="section-title-label" />
<HBox spacing="10"> <Label text="Département:" /> </HBox> <HBox spacing="12"> <ToggleButton fx:id="tbDeptB2B" text="Centre d'appel B2B" styleClass="toggle-dept" /> <ToggleButton fx:id="tbDeptB2C" text="Centre d'appel B2C" styleClass="toggle-dept" /> <ToggleButton fx:id="tbDeptBureau" text="Bureau d'étude" styleClass="toggle-dept" /> </HBox>
<GridPane hgap="14" vgap="12"> <columnConstraints> <ColumnConstraints percentWidth="33" /> <ColumnConstraints percentWidth="33" /> <ColumnConstraints percentWidth="34" /> </columnConstraints>
<Label text="Profil / Poste:" GridPane.rowIndex="0" GridPane.columnIndex="0" /> <TextField fx:id="tfProfil" promptText="Agent call, Ingénieur..." GridPane.rowIndex="0" GridPane.columnIndex="0" />
<Label text="Date d'embauche:" GridPane.rowIndex="0" GridPane.columnIndex="1" /> <DatePicker fx:id="dpEmbauche" GridPane.rowIndex="0" GridPane.columnIndex="1" />
<Label text="Salaire mensuel net TND:" GridPane.rowIndex="0" GridPane.columnIndex="2" /> <TextField fx:id="tfSalaire" GridPane.rowIndex="0" GridPane.columnIndex="2" />
<!-- Row 2 --> <Label text="Type de contrat:" GridPane.rowIndex="1" GridPane.columnIndex="0" /> <HBox spacing="8" GridPane.rowIndex="1" GridPane.columnIndex="0"> <ToggleButton fx:id="tbContratCDI" text="CDI" styleClass="toggle-contrat" /> <ToggleButton fx:id="tbContratCDD" text="CDD" styleClass="toggle-contrat" /> <ToggleButton fx:id="tbContratStage" text="Stage" styleClass="toggle-contrat" /> </HBox>
<Label text="Statut:" GridPane.rowIndex="1" GridPane.columnIndex="1" /> <HBox spacing="8" GridPane.rowIndex="1" GridPane.columnIndex="1"> <ToggleButton fx:id="tbStatutActif" text="Actif" style="-fx-background-color:#4F6815; -fx-text-fill:white;" /> <ToggleButton fx:id="tbStatutInactif" text="Inactif" style="-fx-background-color:#75070C; -fx-text-fill:white;" /> </HBox> </GridPane> </VBox>
<!-- SECTION 3: Informations bancaires --> <VBox spacing="8" styleClass="card"> <Label text="INFORMATIONS BANCAIRES" styleClass="section-title-label" /> <GridPane hgap="14" vgap="12"> <columnConstraints> <ColumnConstraints percentWidth="50" /> <ColumnConstraints percentWidth="50" /> </columnConstraints>
<Label text="N° RIB:" GridPane.rowIndex="0" GridPane.columnIndex="0" /> <TextField fx:id="tfRIB" promptText="TN59 1234..." GridPane.rowIndex="0" GridPane.columnIndex="0" />
<Label text="Banque:" GridPane.rowIndex="0" GridPane.columnIndex="1" /> <ComboBox fx:id="cbBanque" GridPane.rowIndex="0" GridPane.columnIndex="1"> <items> <FXCollections fx:factory="observableArrayList"> <String fx:value="STB" /> <String fx:value="BNA" /> <String fx:value="BIAT" /> <String fx:value="Attijari Bank" /> <String fx:value="BH Bank" /> <String fx:value="UIB" /> <String fx:value="Autre" /> </FXCollections> </items> </ComboBox> </GridPane> </VBox>
<!-- FOOTER --> <HBox spacing="12" style="-fx-padding:12; -fx-background-color:#FDFAF7; -fx-border-color:#F0E6DA; -fx-border-width:1 0 0 0;"> <Button text="Annuler" fx:id="btnCancel" /> <Pane HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS" /> <Button text="Enregistrer et ajouter un autre" fx:id="btnSaveAndAdd" styleClass="btn-olive" /> <Button text="Créer la fiche employé" fx:id="btnCreate" styleClass="btn-primary" /> </HBox>
</VBox> </content> </ScrollPane>
